text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thunk… Thunk…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the winter holidays, and I wake up one morning to the sound of something hitting my window. Opening the curtains, I find…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Come on down! Look at all this snow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A snowball clutched in one hand, Matikanetannhauser waves to me with the other.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wow! Everywhere you look, it's a winter wonderland!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And just in time for the holidays! What could be more magical than this?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser is like an excited puppy. Still, it's freezing. I start marching in place to warm my body up, when…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whomp…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hehe, gotcha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …I get hit by a snowball.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! You're all covered in snow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not going to just stand here and get walloped. I pack a snowball of my own and hurl it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yah! Good one! But, how do you like… this?! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff… Hehehe, snowball fights are so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm surprised you've got such a childlike side to you, Trainer. Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Phew… What should we do next?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …Wait, I almost forgot! Come with me for a sec!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She leads me to a spot where a small, solitary snowman stands.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I made it before I went to get you—a "snow Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I wanted to show you this, but I totally forgot!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Here, take a good look at its eyes! Don't they look like yours?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just like she said, I kinda can see the resemblance.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I'll have you know I put in the work!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems she worked really hard on it, so I want to do something for her in return.
choice_data_list: Then how about I make a snow Tannhauser to go with it?
Then how about I make a snow Tannhauser to go with it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What?! A me snowman?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few hours later, and with some trial and error, I manage to make a snowman that looks like Matikanetannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wooow! Thanks so much! It looks just like me! I think!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's put them right next to each other!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hehe, they're so cute! Wouldn't it be nice if they never melted?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I end up spending an unforgettable day with Matikanetannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She leads me to a lone igloo.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I made it before I went to get you—I call it Iglooey!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I wanted to show you this, but I totally forgot!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Do you want to go inside? It's warmer than you'd think.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I do as she says and enter the igloo. It's pretty cramped, but also strangely cozy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Wouldn't it be nice if we could grill up some mochi in here?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hm, I've heard before that snow absorbs sound, but it's pretty quiet in here, huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's quiet, warm, and beautiful… And you're right by my side…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser shuffles herself closer and rests her head on my shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hehe, this is so relaxing…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Can we stay like this for a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …Yay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Snow begins to fall silently outside the igloo, and we take in the beautiful, snowy landscape.
